display.title: Kill the Netherite Monstrosity
display.subtitle: Boss kill
description: A huge Nether boss guarding the Soul Forge. Bring strong armour, potions and plenty of food.
Find the Soul Forge in the Nether (Crimson Forest, Warped Forest, Soul Sand Valley or Nether Wastes). An Eye of Monstrous, used like an Eye of Ender, points to it.
